description: device / Panorama / SCM settings handled generically by pan-os-php type=config-section (utils/common/ConfigSection.php). 'kind': entries (named entries, default) or settings (one container of fields). 'base': device (default - relative to the device entry /config/devices/entry[@name='localhost.localdomain'], or the template config) or config (relative to <config>: mgt-config, shared, panorama; a template: its <config>). 'paths': a path per scope (panorama / firewall / template / scm) instead of 'path'. 'scope': panorama, firewall, template, scm (relative to the entry of the SCM folder / snippet / device, location=). 'exclude': child elements left out of a settings section (sections of their own). 'group': heading in the config viewer (System). 'references': yes = text values are matched against device group / template / template stack names and managed firewall serials (Panorama). Values of secret fields (password hash, keys, PSK, community) and values encrypted with the master key are never shown.

deployment-update-schedule.description: Panorama: Device Deployment > Dynamic Updates > Schedules (content updates of managed firewalls: app-and-threat, anti-virus, wildfire, ... - devices = serials)

config-bundle-export-schedule.description: Panorama: scheduled config bundle export (SCP / FTP server)

permitted-ip.description: permitted IP addresses of the management interface
